description:
About Ever.green: 

 Ever.green is a climate startup based in Seattle on a mission to accelerate the transition to clean energy by bringing corporate capital to renewable energy projects. We enable companies with sustainability goals to commit to forward contracts for high-impact Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) that help stand up new solar and wind projects in areas with high grid emissions. We are building a platform to help companies manage REC contracts, creating insight into how their REC purchases address their energy usage across various grid regions where they operate. 

 We’re a small, nimble team made up of energy executives, legal experts, and tech veterans. We’re lucky to be supported by amazing investors and are excited to be growing our team. Check out recent press and read more about Ever.green on our website and our blog .

 About the role: 

 You will be the second engineer on a small product team building out Ever.green’s REC management platform. You’ll collaborate closely with design and product counterparts to prioritize, build, and deploy new releases on a weekly cadence.

 This role is an excellent opportunity for someone with full stack software engineering experience who is passionate about sustainability and clean energy, and wants to make a huge impact on a startup in its pivotal stages.

 This role is Seattle based, with a few days a week in office. We’ll also consider strong candidates from US timezones who can travel to Seattle periodically.

 What You'll Do:

 
 Own the technical design and development of Ever.green’s flagship product, from data models and APIs to background jobs and integrations

 Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to define and prioritize the product roadmap

 Take ownership of features the team ships, reviewing code, QA on staging, validating results on production

 Share responsibility for production health, addressing errors and incidents during working hours, with occasional after-hours response for critical issues like security incidents

 Identify opportunities and lead efforts to improve engineering excellence and best practices within the product

 
 What We're Looking For : 

 
 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant work with TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, and relational data modeling

 Experience deploying production applications with infrastructure as code (SST, CDK, Terraform, or similar)

 Proven track record designing, developing, and owning robust full-stack applications, including background job processing and third-party integrations

 Comfortable turning business requirements into specs, breaking large projects into small, shippable pieces, and building from designs within an established component system

 Startup experience: comfortable wearing many hats, thriving in ambiguity, and proactively building out Ever.green’s knowledge base to set the team up for success

 Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools to speed up development, balanced with detailed planning and careful validation of results

 Self-managing, but energized by cross-functional collaboration

 Excellent at communicating technical concepts and engineering timelines to non-technical teammates

 A curious, continuous learner who is eager to join our climate mission and collaborate with outstanding peers to deliver on a shared vision

 
 Benefits: 

 
 Competitive Salary

 Stock Options

 Medical, dental, & vision insurance coverage for you + partially covered for your dependents

 Discretionary Personal Time Off

 Paid Parental Leave

 
 Why Ever.green: 

 Join a small, tight-knit team where your work and your voice both carry real weight.

 Build an offering with a genuine, differentiated story and a proven track record with major brands.

 Work at the center of the energy transition, with a direct line between your day-to-day work and real climate impact.

 Based in Seattle, WA, with flexibility to work remotely.

 Please note: AI agent applications will be deprioritized.
